message.content: Painting the Eiffel Tower would be a massive undertaking. The tower stands about 330 m (1,083 ft) tall and has a complex lattice structure. A rough estimate—based on the amount of surface area (roughly 10,000 m² of metal) and typical industrial painting rates—suggests that it could take several months to a year or more, depending on crew size, weather, and safety constraints. In practice, such a project would involve extensive planning, permits, and coordination with French authorities.
